children: Overview
UK promotional products technology provider's half-year revenue grew 4% yr/yr to £60.7 mln
Adjusted EPS for the half-year rose 3% yr/yr to 1.25p
Company completed £7 mln share buyback, returning £10 mln to shareholders in 2026
Outlook
Pebble Group expects FY 26 results to be in line with market expectations
Facilisgroup targeting double-digit revenue growth in H2 26
Pebble Group expects net cash at 31 Dec 2026 to be about £5.0m
Result Drivers
RECURRING REVENUE GROWTH - Facilisgroup's recurring technology subscription fees and new multi-year contracts strengthened revenue profile and visibility
NEW CONTRACT WINS - Brand Addition's revenue growth driven by momentum from 2025 new contract wins and high client retention
INVESTMENT IMPACT - Increased investment in Facilisgroup to support partner growth moderated margins
